Usage: agentcage cage shell [OPTIONS] NAME

  Open an interactive shell in a cage container.

Options:
  -s, --service [cage|egress]  Container service to shell into.  [default: cage]
  --as-root                    Open the shell as root (uid 0) instead of the
                               workload's uid 1000 user (debug only).
  --no-color                   Disable colored output.
  --quiet                      Suppress progress output (spinners and banners).
  -h, --help                   Show this message and exit.
